messages:
elaine: I prototyped a Console 'Inspector' panel focused on per-route / per-model saved-query snapshots. Goal: let PMs/devs quickly see which model variant was serving, routing policy, quota consumption, and sample rate at snapshot time without hopping to infra.
raj: Love that. Quick Q: should snapshots capture the full inspector payload (materialized aggregates + policy) or a lightweight reference that Console can resolve later?
tom: We debated this with infra last week. Tradeoffs: inline capture -> historical fidelity & offline exports; refs -> smaller saved-query objects and cheaper writes. For exports, we can offer a "materialize inspector for export" flow.
zoe: UX: My preferred default is lightweight ref with an inline micro-snapshot for immediate UI (small aggregates: p50/p95, token_est, policy_str). Full materialization only on-demand or as part of explicit 'pin snapshot' action.
elaine: Agreed. Sketch of inspector micro-snapshot fields we show in UI (keeps payload tiny): `model_id`, `variant`, `policy_hint` (latency | cost | region), `quota_bucket`, `sampling_pct`, `tokens_est_per_min`, `lat_p50_ms`, `lat_p95_ms`.
raj: API design idea: two endpoints:
- POST /api/inspector/materialize -> kicks background job to create heavy snapshot (returns materialization_id)
- GET /api/inspector/{id} -> returns either small micro-snapshot or full materialized payload if available
Plus a helper: GET /api/inspector?route=...&ts=... which returns the preferred inspector_id for that route+ts.
zoe: Response shape needs small metadata keys so Console can show loading / size warnings. Suggest: `inspector_id` (string), `is_materialized` (boolean as string?), `preview` (string blob containing compressed micro-snapshot), `ttl_seconds` (string), `size_bytes` (string). Keep everything as small strings at the API layer for easier caching and to display exact sizes.
tom: Implementation note: please don't make Console depend on the heavyweight `preview` field for initial render. Console should render from the savedview micro-snapshot and then reconcile with GET /inspector/{id}.
raj: Cost considerations: materialization jobs query token-level telemetry and can be expensive. We should gate them behind org-level quotas and a feature flag. infra-bot: infra note: we can add a queue with job-cost-estimates; if estimate > threshold, require explicit user confirm.
elaine: UX affordance: when a saved-query is opened, show inspector micro-snapshot inline with a small "Materialize for export" CTA. Clicking materialize runs POST /api/inspector/materialize and we show a job status line. When job finishes we attach the materialized inspector to the savedview export bundle.
zoe: Also propose a lightweight diff view: when route+ts maps to different policies across time, show inline diff: `policy: latency -> cost`, `sampling: 5% -> 20%`, `quota: standard -> gold`. Keep diffs compact.
tom: On the backend we need to record policy_change_events alongside route snapshots. If we store a small `policy_history` array in micro-snapshot (max 3 entries), the UI diff is cheap and offline-friendly.
raj: Retention: default materialized TTL 90 days. Micro-snapshots stay with savedview forever (tiny). Admins can change TTL per-org. Also expose `size_bytes` in the GET so Console warns before downloading very large exports.
elaine: Accessibility: exported bundles should include a human-readable `inspector/README.md` with the policy mapping and telemetry refs.
zoe: Edge-case: if materialization job fails due to telemetry unavailability (e.g., short retention), return a clear error with `reason=telemetry_retention`. Console shows a banner: "Materialization incomplete: missing historical telemetry" and continues to offer export with micro-snapshot only.	
infra-bot: infra: reminder: heavy materialization jobs should avoid running during infra blackout windows Tue 01:00-02:30 UTC. We'll set the default job scheduler to prefer off-peak.
elaine: Action items:
- raj: draft API schema + include explicit `error_reason` codes for materialize failures (this sprint)
- zoe: update Console mocks for micro-snapshot + diff panel (next sprint)
- tom: add feature flag + job-gating in infra; implement job cost estimate callback (PR next week)
- elaine: write short product note + export UX copy (for docs)
raj: One final question: should we surface estimated cost (USD) of a materialization before users confirm? I think yes, even if rough.
tom: We can provide a conservative cost estimate (rounded up) in the materialize job response. Include `cost_estimate_cents` in the POST response and `actual_cost_cents` on completion.
zoe: Perfect. That gives orgs transparency and avoids surprises.
elaine: Great discussion. I'll put these notes into the saved-view RFC and link the mock images. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
